mechanics.title: Configuration
mechanics.description: Colors for cuboid, polygon, ellipsoid and cylinder regions and chunk boundaries are configurable via Mod Menu.

commands_and_keybinds: Controls: Toggle CUI visibility, Clear WorldEdit selection, Toggle Chunk Border
name: WorldEdit CUI
summary: Client-side display for WorldEdit selections: draws selection outlines and grids in the world. It needs WorldEdit on the server or world.
